verdict.rationale: Aircall's own documented features include rule-like automation on call events: IVR keypad routing combined with business-hours scheduling, and AI Assistants that automatically update CRM records and create follow-up tasks after conversations. However, there is no evidence of a general user-configurable rules or workflow builder. Webhooks, the API and the smart-routing tutorials are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented no-code rule/trigger-action builder, user-defined conditions across arbitrary event types, configurable action catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
